Procesamiento Me interesa... ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} d <- absolute_judgements |> mutate(term = str_wrap(term, 10)) |> mutate(term = fct_reorder(term, probability)) d_m <- reframe( d, probability = Hmisc::smean.cl.boot(probability)[1], .by = term ) ``` ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} c1 <- "#92351d" c2 <- "#e69c6b" c3 <- "#ecb27d" g <- ggplot(d, aes(probability, term)) + geom_point(size = 1, alpha = .3, color = c2) + geom_point( data = d_m, shape = 23, size = 8, fill = c3, color = c2, stroke = 1 ) + geom_point( data = d_m, shape = 21, size = 4, fill = "white", color = c2, stroke = 1 ) + scale_x_continuous( breaks = scales::breaks_width(10), expand = expansion(add = 1, mult = 0) ) + scale_y_discrete( expand = expansion(add = .25, mult = 0) ) + coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + labs(x = "Probabilidad (%)", y = NULL) + ggthemes::theme_few(base_family = "ubuntu", base_size = 22) + theme_sub_axis( ticks = element_blank(), text = element_text(color = c1), title = element_text(face = "bold", color = c1, hjust = 1) ) + theme_sub_axis_left(text = element_text(face = "bold")) + theme_sub_panel( background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA), border = element_blank() ) + theme_sub_plot(background = element_rect(fill = "white")) ggsave( plot = g, filename = "tidytuesday/2026/semana_10.png", width = 30, height = 35, units = "cm" ) browseURL("tidytuesday/2026/semana_10.png") ``` ::: ##
